description: Thermal mass flow meter for compressed air and gases, Modbus RTU (RS485)
source: BEKO TECHNOLOGIES, METPOINT VFS TI / TM, Original installation and service instructions 10-447, version 00.02, 31 March 2025

sources.title: METPOINT VFS TI / TM, Original installation and service instructions (10-447)

notes: The manual gives the addresses without saying whether they are 0- or 1-based. The one example it gives (holding register 0x07D0 is decimal 2000) is a wire address, so they are given here as 0-based. If a read fails, try address_base 1.
Defaults from the manual: 19200 baud, 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit, slave address 247. When the address is changed it can be 1 to 246.
Byte order is ABCD for floats and 32-bit integers (big-endian words). Each float takes two registers.

The manual lists the 4.6.3 table as Read Input Registers (0x04) and the 4.6.6 table as Write Multiple Holding Registers (0x10). The holding registers are given as RW; the manual does not say they can be read back with 0x03.
Input and holding registers use the same numbers for different things (3222, 3400 to 3406): they are separate address spaces.
Error flags: register 3200 holds all flags as a bit field (the manual numbers the bits 1 to 16, here 0 to 15). Registers 3201 to 3216 repeat each flag as a register; the manual lists no Error9 flag.
In the manual's unit lists for registers 3400 and 3701, value 4 is printed as l/h, the same as value 2. It is most likely l/s.
Changing the interface parameters is a three step write: 0xAC1D to register 5010, the parameter word to register 2000, then 0xBA5E to register 5020; restart the device afterwards.
The device also answers Read Device Identification (0x2B / 0x0E) with the vendor, product code, software version and serial number as text; this is not a register, so it is not in the map.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.
